2: "Yehuda ben Teima says: 'Be bold as a leopard...' – He detailed four things in the service of the Creator, blessed be He. (Why four?) Because at first glance it would seem that these things are actually two (pairs): 'light as an eagle' would correspond to 'swift as a deer', and 'bold as a leopard' would correspond to 'strong as a lion'. If this were so, one could ask Yehuda ben Teima: why did he double the idea in different terms, twice? This is why (the Tur) wrote that these are indeed four distinct qualities, as he will explain."
